acf.h1_service_page: PPC Marketing That Converts Clicks Into Customers
acf.h2_paragraph_3:
Data-Driven PPC Marketing That Delivers Measurable Growth

Every decision is backed by performance data. We track cost per click, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, and revenue attribution at the keyword level. Weekly optimisation prevents the performance decay that affects unmanaged campaigns.
acf.why_us_h3_paragraph: Rank Ray has managed PPC campaigns for businesses across healthcare, finance, technology, ecommerce, franchise, and professional services. We combine platform expertise with business strategy, ensuring your campaigns serve revenue goals rather than vanity metrics.
acf.services_1_paragraph: We identify high-intent keywords that indicate purchase readiness. Selection balances search volume, competition level, commercial value, and conversion probability.
acf.services_2_paragraph: Ad copy is written for conversion, not clicks. We test multiple variations against your value propositions and rotate the creative that drives the highest return at lowest cost.
acf.services_3_paragraph: Landing pages are optimised for the specific campaign that sends the traffic. Headlines match messaging, forms are shortened, and mobile load times are minimised to prevent abandonment.
acf.services_4_paragraph: We implement tracking at the keyword and campaign level. Granularity reveals which specific searches produce leads and which waste budget, enabling precise reallocation.
acf.services_5_paragraph: Weekly performance reports show spend efficiency, conversion trends, and competitive positioning. Monthly strategic reviews adjust campaign architecture based on market shifts.
acf.services_6_paragraph: Once efficiency benchmarks are met, we expand into new territories, additional formats, and complementary channels. Growth is systematic, not speculative.
acf.why_us_box_1_paragraph: Our strategists are certified across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and Meta platforms. Platform expertise ensures your campaigns leverage every available feature for competitive advantage.
acf.why_us_box_2_paragraph: We build campaigns with single-keyword ad groups, negative keyword sculpting, and automated bid rules. Structure determines performance before a single impression is served.
acf.why_us_box_3_paragraph: Campaign fatigue is real. We refresh creative every fourteen days, test new approaches, and rotate messaging to maintain engagement and conversion rates as markets evolve.
acf.why_us_box_4_paragraph: We build comprehensive negative filters that block irrelevant traffic before it costs you money. This discipline typically reduces wasted spend by twenty to thirty percent in the first month.
acf.why_us_box_5_paragraph: Every campaign structure is designed for scalability. Whether you spend thousands or hundreds of thousands monthly, the architecture supports clean expansion.
acf.why_us_box_6_paragraph: We report on metrics that matter to your business: cost per lead, return on ad spend, customer acquisition cost, and pipeline contribution. No vanity metrics. No confusion.
acf.answer_1: PPC management is the practice of building, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising. We handle strategy, execution, tracking, and ongoing refinement.
acf.answer_2: We manage Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and Meta platforms. Each platform serves different audiences and intents, and we allocate budget to the channels that produce the best return.
acf.question_3: How often do you optimize campaigns?
acf.answer_3: We optimize daily during launch phases, then weekly once benchmarks are established. Continuous testing ensures campaigns improve over time rather than decay.
acf.answer_4: Yes. We design and test landing pages specifically for PPC traffic. Headlines match ad messaging, forms are optimized, and mobile experience is prioritised for conversion.
acf.question_5: What kind of reports do I get?
acf.answer_5: Weekly performance reports show spend, conversions, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend. Monthly strategic reviews include trend analysis and recommendations.
acf.question_6: Can you audit my existing account?
acf.answer_6: Yes. We audit existing accounts to identify structural issues, wasted spend, and missed opportunities. Most accounts can be restructured and improved within the first month.
acf.question_7: Is there a minimum ad budget?
acf.answer_7: We work with budgets of all sizes. We start with conservative testing budgets, identify the highest-converting segments, and scale based on performance data.
acf.answer_8: Tell us your monthly budget, target locations, and primary conversion goals. We deliver a customised strategy within forty eight hours.
acf.question_9: Can you manage multi-location or franchise PPC?
acf.answer_9: Yes. We manage multi-location PPC with location-specific campaigns, local landing pages, and unified reporting. Each location targets its own market while maintaining brand consistency.
acf.answer_10: We combine certified platform expertise with business strategy. Every campaign decision is tied to revenue impact, not vanity metrics. We report on pipeline contribution, not just clicks.
